answers.q1: Maven, via the checked-in Maven Wrapper (pom.xml, Spring Boot 4.1.0 parent, Java 17). Install dependencies with: ./mvnw -B dependency:go-offline (Gradle is also configured in build.gradle, but the Maven build is the primary one, and CI runs it).
answers.q4: ./mvnw -B validate (this runs the spring-javaformat validate goal and the nohttp checkstyle check bound to the validate phase, as declared in pom.xml; CI's ./mvnw -B verify also runs these before tests)
answers.q5: src/main/resources/static/resources/css/petclinic.css is generated by the libsass plugin (css Maven profile in pom.xml) from src/main/scss/*.scss (petclinic.scss, header.scss, typography.scss, responsive.scss), so edit the .scss sources instead. The generated/unpacked webjars output under target/ (e.g. target/webjars) and build/ or .gradle/ are build output, not hand-edited files. No vendored code is checked in; the Bootstrap and Font Awesome assets come from Maven dependencies.
